skill_title: Choose or critique an appropriate scale
notes: 20-item bank Gr 11-12. CAPS mix: 10 L3 / 10 L4. Pick scale to fit page; critique given scale; common A4 = 297×210 mm.

stimulus.inline: Sketch a 4 m × 3 m room on A4 paper (~25 cm × 18 cm usable).

items.question: Which scale fits?
workingSteps: At 1:25: 4 m = 16 cm; 3 m = 12 cm — fits comfortably on A4.
1:10 too big (40 cm); 1:100 too small (4 cm); 1:1 000 way too small.

stimulus.inline: Show entire SA province (~400 km wide) on A4 (~25 cm wide).
Map of suburb 2 km × 1 km on A4.

items.question: Best scale?
workingSteps: Or check: 2 km ÷ 10 000 = 20 cm wide. Fits A4.

stimulus.inline: Drawing of a 25 mm bolt on A4.

items.question: Best scale?
workingSteps: 1:1 shows 25 mm; 10:1 enlarges to 250 mm — good detail on A4.

stimulus.inline: Floor plan of 3-bedroom house on A4.

items.question: Best scale?
workingSteps: A house is ~10 m wide. 1:50 → 20 cm — fits A4.

stimulus.inline: World map (~40 000 km wide) on A4.
Critique: cell-phone screen (~6 cm × 3 cm) for a national-park hiking map.

items.question: Verdict?
options: Too small — trails will be illegible.
items.expectedAnswer: Too small — trails will be illegible.
workingSteps: A park is many km wide; screen would need impractical scale.

stimulus.inline: Scale 1:10 chosen to draw a 5 m house on A4.

items.question: Critique.
options: Too small — house drawn would be only 50 cm.
Too large — house drawn would be 50 cm, larger than A4.
items.expectedAnswer: Too large — house drawn would be 50 cm, larger than A4.
workingSteps: 5 m ÷ 10 = 50 cm. Exceeds A4 ~25 cm wide.

stimulus.inline: 5 m sketch at 1:200 on A4.
Draw a 200 m stretch of road on A4 (25 cm long).
Architect's plan of 3 m × 2 m bathroom at 1:25.
Critique: scale 1:5 chosen to draw a 30 m × 15 m school field on A4 paper (25 cm × 18 cm).

items.question: Verdict?
options: Too large — drawing would be 6 m × 3 m, way bigger than paper.
Too small — drawing would be 6 cm × 3 cm, too small to read.
items.expectedAnswer: Too large — drawing would be 6 m × 3 m, way bigger than paper.
workingSteps: 30 m ÷ 5 = 6 m = 600 cm. Wildly off paper.

stimulus.inline: Pick scale: draw a 12 m × 8 m hall on A4.

items.question: Best scale?
workingSteps: At 1:50: 12 m → 24 cm, 8 m → 16 cm — fits A4.

stimulus.inline: Field 100 m × 50 m on A4.
Critique: a 1:1 000 floor plan of 4 m × 3 m bedroom.

items.question: Verdict?
options: Drawing too small to read (room = 4 mm × 3 mm).
items.expectedAnswer: Drawing too small to read (room = 4 mm × 3 mm).

stimulus.inline: Sketch a 1,5 m × 1 m table on A3 paper (~40 cm × 28 cm).
Map of Joburg metro ~50 km wide on A2 (~60 cm wide).
Detail drawing of a 20 mm screw on A4.

items.question: Best scale?
workingSteps: 20 mm at 10:1 = 200 mm — readable detail on A4.

stimulus.inline: House plan: 12 m × 9 m on A4.

items.question: Best scale and resulting plan dimensions.

stimulus.inline: Geography textbook map of South Africa ~1 500 km wide on a 20 cm wide page.

_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_SCALE_FIT: Picks a scale that does not match the page size.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_SCALE_DIRECTION: Multiplies when divide was needed (or vice versa).
